Title: Customer Support AI Assistant Rollout Meeting
Time: Thursday, 14 March, 10:00–11:00 AM
Description: We'll be reviewing the new AI assistant that answers common customer queries on our website. Priya from Product will demo the chatbot's escalation flow, and Tom from Support will share first-week metrics. Please bring any feedback from your teams about tricky customer interactions. This is an internal meeting; no customer data should be discussed outside the room.

Title: Laptop Return and Refund Processing
Time: Friday, 15 March, 2:00–2:30 PM
Description: Join a quick call to walk through the refund steps for order #A47291 (the faulty laptop). We'll confirm the return label has been issued and check the payment timeline.

Title: Product Recall Communication Planning
Time: Monday, 18 March, 9:00–10:30 AM
Description: Following the safety notice on the Kingston kettle model K-200, we need to align on customer messaging. The meeting will cover:
- Draft email to affected customers
- FAQ updates for the website
- Script for phone support

Please review the draft recall notice attached to the calendar invite before the meeting. Maria from Legal will join to ensure compliance. We will also discuss how our AI assistant should handle recall-related queries. Note: the AI assistant's knowledge base must be updated before the announcement goes live.

Agenda:
1. Recall scope and timeline (15 min)
2. Customer communication channels (20 min)
3. AI assistant response review (20 min)
4. Next steps (15 min)

If you cannot attend, please send your comments to the recall task force.

Title: Weekly Sync: Support Automation Updates
Time: Wednesday, 20 March, 3:00–3:45 PM
Description: This week's sync will focus on the new automated tool that routes customer emails to the right department. We'll look at the routing accuracy report and discuss any misrouted tickets. Please add items to the shared agenda doc.

Also, we'll have a quick demo of the suggested-reply feature for agents. It's not customer-facing yet.

Title: Refund Policy Review for Laptop Orders
Time: Tuesday, 19 March, 11:00 AM–12:00 PM
Description: We'll review the current refund policy specifically for laptop purchases. Recent cases have highlighted confusion around restocking fees and return windows. The goal is to clarify the wording and update the help center articles.

Please bring examples of recent laptop refund requests where customers expressed dissatisfaction. We'll also check how the AI assistant explains the policy to customers, so bring screenshots of any chatbot conversations that need improvement.

Title: Recall Notice Draft Review
Time: Thursday, 21 March, 1:00–2:00 PM
Description: Meet to review the draft customer email for the kettle recall. We'll finalize the language and schedule the send. Please read the draft beforehand and note any edits. The AI assistant's FAQ will be updated after the email goes out, so no need to worry about that yet.

Title: Quick Chat: Laptop Refund Status
Time: Today, 4:00–4:15 PM
Description: Just a brief call to confirm the refund for order #B88912 has been processed and to check if the customer has been notified.

Title: AI Assistant Training Data Review
Time: Friday, 22 March, 10:30–11:30 AM
Description: We'll go over the latest batch of customer queries used to train the support chatbot. Please review the flagged examples in the shared spreadsheet and come ready to discuss which ones should be excluded. This is to improve accuracy and avoid biased responses.

Title: Recall Impact on Refund Process
Time: Wednesday, 27 March, 9:30–10:15 AM
Description: This meeting will address how the kettle recall affects refunds for customers who bought the recalled product. We need to decide whether to offer full refunds or replacements, and how to handle shipping costs. The AI assistant will need updated scripts, so please prepare a list of common customer questions about the recall.

Title: Chatbot Performance Metrics Deep Dive
Time: Monday, 25 March, 2:00–3:00 PM
Description: Join us to analyze the support chatbot's performance over the last quarter. We'll look at resolution rates, escalation triggers, and customer satisfaction scores. Please bring any feedback on specific chatbot conversations that seemed off. This will help us fine-tune the automated responses.
